description: Display-only mapping of segments.<segment>.stenosis_pct to the % shown in the report (display_pct) and its category (display_category), for model v15. stenosis_pct, prob_significant and every flag are unchanged. One mapping for every displayed segment. Kept to redraw results stored by containers 2.0.0 and 2.1.0 (model v15); not applied to v19.
rules: otherwise: linear interpolation through the knots, rounded down to an integer, so an estimate below a knot stays in the category below it (the fitted category boundaries are exactly 21.5, 34.5 and 49.5)
significant flag: never shown as normal; an estimate below zero_below_pct is shown at the first display knot (20%, mild)

provenance.source: display_mapping.json and thresholds/display_mapping.json of the v15 release dossier (also in the Hugging Face revision v15.1); script evaluation/fit_display_mapping.py
provenance.dataset_short: the MHI validation split of model v15 (4,647 studies, 78,999 segment readings; posterior LV branch excluded from the fit)
provenance.dataset: MHI validation split only, no test data: 4,647 studies x 17 segments = 78,999 segment readings of the served v15 weights, with the angiography report stenosis. The posterior left ventricular (LVP) rows were excluded: LVP has no training target in v15 and is not displayed. The model estimate was clipped to 0-100 as the container does.
provenance.method: cal1, the method of the v13 mapping, refitted on v15. T0: among cuts 0, 0.5, ..., 40 (shown normal when estimate < cut), the largest cut whose Youden J for report stenosis > 0% is within 0.002 of the maximum, all fitted segments pooled. Knots for the 30/50/70 boundaries on a 1-point grid from T0+1: the triple that maximises the quadratic-weighted Cohen kappa between the 5 report categories and the 5 shown categories (0, <30, 30-49, 50-69, >=70; shown category from estimate < T0, < a, < b, < c). The display value at T0 is the report's mild label (20%). Fit on all validation rows: 9.5 / 21.5 / 34.5 / 49.5, used as fitted (half points are not rounded). 5-fold cross-validation grouped by patient, 3 seeds: T0 9.5 to 10.5 and knots 21-22 / 34-35 / 47-50.5 across folds.

validation_metrics_with_flag_rule.note: With the rule that a segment flagged for significant stenosis is never shown as normal (estimate below T0 and flagged -> mild). This is what the report shows.

provenance.not_in_the_dossier: Sensitivity, specificity, PPV and NPV of the T0 cut, per-vessel kappa and the mean report value per shown category were published for the v13 mapping; the v15 dossier does not give them.
